question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-25
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age_year
    +
    -- Add 1 if birthday has occurred on or before 2026-09-25
    CASE
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) * 100 + SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) <= 0925 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) = 25;

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-24
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR('2026-09-24', 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
  ) =
  CASE
    -- If birthday hasn't occurred yet this year, subtract 1
    WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '09-24'
      THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END
  AND
  -- Ensure exactly 25 completed years
  SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) <= '09-24';

JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-26
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age_year
    -- Adjust if birthday hasn't occurred yet this year
    + CASE
        WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '09-26'
          THEN -1
        ELSE 0
      END
  ) = 25;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE (
    -- Calculate age on 2026-09-24: exactly 25 years old
    -- Born on a date such that the 25th anniversary is <= 2026-09-24
    -- and the 26th anniversary is > 2026-09-24
    -- This means birth_date must be between 2001-09-25 and 2001-09-24 (inclusive)
    -- Actually: 25th anniversary = birth_date + 25 years
    -- For age to be exactly 25 on 2026-09-24:
    -- birth_date + 25 years <= 2026-09-24
    -- AND birth_date + 26 years > 2026-09-24
    -- So birth_date <= 2001-09-24
    -- AND birth_date > 2000-09-24
    -- Therefore: birth_date > '2000-09-24' AND birth_date <= '2001-09-24'
    c.birth_date > '2000-09-24' 
    AND c.birth_date <= '2001-09-24'
);

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE (
    CAST(substr(o.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 25
    AND (
        CAST(substr(o.date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) > CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER)
        OR (
            CAST(substr(o.date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER)
            AND CAST(substr(o.date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
        )
    )
);

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-12-01 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    -- Calculate completed age on 2026-12-01
    -- Age is exactly 25 if the 25th anniversary of birth is on or before 2026-12-01
    -- and the 26th anniversary is after 2026-12-01
    (
        -- 25th anniversary: birth_date + 25 years
        -- Check if this date is <= 2026-12-01
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+25 years') <= '2026-12-01'
        AND
        -- 26th anniversary: birth_date + 26 years
        -- Check if this date is > 2026-12-01
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+26 years') > '2026-12-01'
    );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    -- Exactly 25 years old on 2026-09-25
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
     AND CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) < 9)
    OR (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 26
        AND CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) > 9)
    OR (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 26
        AND CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 9
        AND CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) > 25)
    OR (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
        AND CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 9
        AND CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) <= 25)
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of products a, b and c only, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c')
  AND (
    (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25) < CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
    OR (
      (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25) = CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
      AND (
        CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) < CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 6, 2) AS INTEGER)
        OR (
          CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 6, 2) AS INTEGER)
          AND CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) <= CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
        )
      )
    )
  )
  AND NOT (
    (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 26) < CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
    OR (
      (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 26) = CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
      AND (
        CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) < CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 6, 2) AS INTEGER)
        OR (
          CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 6, 2) AS INTEGER)
          AND CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) <= CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
        )
      )
    )
  );
